description: On a two-point carrier, the empty set and the two singletons form a downward closed family whose symmetric-difference relation fails transitivity.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.smallCollection_counterexample :
  ∅ ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.smallCollection ∧
    IsLowerSet Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.smallCollection ∧
      symmDiff {0} ∅ ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.smallCollection ∧
        symmDiff ∅ {1} ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.smallCollection ∧
          symmDiff {0} {1} = Set.univ ∧
            Set.univ ∉ Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.smallCollection ∧
              ¬IsTrans (Set (Fin 2)) fun A B => symmDiff A B ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.smallCollection
